description: For the agent in the call (`session`): returns a helper credential `token` (with `url` and `expires_in`) that lets other sessions working for the same person add their own status board, decisions and activity lines to this call without joining (no voice, no chip). `label` = name of the helper's machine, max 22 chars, shown as 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>'. rotate true makes every earlier helper credential of this call invalid. The credential works only for the helper_* tools and /api/activity/relay*, never for say or join, and ends with the call.

label.description: Machine label of the helper, max 22 chars.
label.title: Label
